content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

A no-KYC payment gateway is a system that enables digital sellers to accept payments without requiring customers to undergo Know Your Customer (KYC) verification. This is crucial for creators in Kenya, where traditional payment platforms are often unavailable or restricted. By bypassing KYC requirements, creators can focus on what matters most: producing high-quality digital products and connecting with their audience. This approach also ensures that creators maintain ownership and control over their sales process, free from the constraints of third-party platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC payment gateway relies on a combination of cutting-edge technologies, including blockchain-based payment processing and automated delivery systems. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed on-chain, eliminating the need for intermediaries. The seller receives the payment directly, without relying on a third-party platform. This approach not only reduces fees but also ensures that sellers have complete control over their sales data and customer interactions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built specifically for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable. In Kenya, for example, creators face significant challenges when trying to sell digital products online. By providing a no-KYC payment gateway, we're empowering these creators to take control of their sales process and connect with a global audience. This isn't just about enabling transactions - it's about creating a more inclusive and equitable digital economy.
Empower your sales process with a no-KYC payment gateway.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a no-KYC payment gateway include a blockchain-based payment processor, an automated delivery system, and a decentralized storage solution. These components work together to enable secure, efficient, and reliable transactions. For example, when a customer purchases a digital product, the payment is processed on-chain, and the product is delivered automatically via a decentralized storage solution. This approach ensures that sellers can focus on producing high-quality products, while the infrastructure handles the rest.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a no-KYC payment gateway today, creators can start by selecting a suitable blockchain-based payment processor and automated delivery system. They can then integrate these components with their existing sales platform, using APIs and other tools to enable seamless transactions. By following this approach, creators can start selling digital products online, without relying on restrictive platforms or intermediaries. With the right infrastructure in place, the possibilities are endless.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Take control of your digital products and customer interactions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Complete Builder Kit, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, offers a comprehensive solution for digital creators looking to deploy a no-KYC payment gateway. This kit provides all the necessary tools and guidance to get started, empowering creators to take control of their sales process and connect with a global audience.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
